verdict.rationale: Luma documents a developer API for video generation. It offers text-to-video, image-to-video and video-to-video, a generation endpoint, and Python/JS/TS SDKs. The legacy Dream Machine reference includes a createGeneration operation with OpenAPI definitions and a Try It runner against api.lumalabs.ai/dream-machine/v1. However, the evidence never shows how to poll for or download the finished asset, and the documented create-generation reference is marked legacy. missing for 10: documented status-polling or asset-retrieval endpoint, a current (non-legacy) generation reference with a full example of creating and retrieving a video, independent hands-on corroboration of the API workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can submit a video generation job through a documented API and retrieve the finished asset

citations.quote: Dream Machine API let's developers use image and video generation capabilities.
Luma API: Two endpoints, Python/JS/TS SDKs, credit-based pricing, production-grade from day one
One reasoning endpoint. One generation endpoint.
The legacy ReadMe-hosted reference runs the "Try It!" request panel against https://api.lumalabs.ai/dream-machine/v1.
